SELECT 
  index_id, 
  value, 
  avail_season, 
  avail_doy 
FROM climate 
WHERE index_id IN ('oni', 'pdo')
ORDER BY avail_season DESC, avail_doy DESC
LIMIT 20

SELECT 
  ts_season, 
  ts_doy,
  ROUND(AVG(wtmp_c) * 1.8 + 32, 1) as temp_f
FROM pier
WHERE ts_season IN (5, 6)
GROUP BY ts_season, ts_doy
ORDER BY ts_season DESC, ts_doy DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT 
  cls,
  fish_date_season as season,
  COUNT(*) as trips,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  ROUND(AVG(yt), 2) as avg_yt_per_trip
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_doy BETWEEN 90 AND 150
  AND fish_date_season IN (2, 3, 4, 5)
GROUP BY cls, fish_date_season
ORDER BY season DESC, cls
LIMIT 40
